reasons.plausibility: Using graphene to enhance thermal conductivity in a HEA matrix is grounded in known material properties, though ensuring uniform dispersion and robust matrix bonding remains a significant practical concern.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled experiment (comparing graphene-doped and undoped samples under realistic conditions) is well-defined and should clearly indicate whether the targeted improvements in thermal and mechanical performance are achieved.
reasons.usefulness: Such an approach is directly relevant to improving heat transfer in plasma-facing reactor applications, providing a tangible strategy for researchers to explore.
